name: backend-file-generator
description: Generate standalone Express and PostgreSQL backends from validated JSON definitions

scripts.build:core: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace generator
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.check: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs && npm run lint
scripts.generate: npm run build:core && node generator/dist/index.js generate
